1 """campaign_acts — what John does on the Campaign page, written into the Campaign's own record through the
2 engine's writer (the CLI and its spine), each act a receipt with its inverse.
3 
4 W3c of the High Seat plan (2026-09-26), trimmed by its Rabbit read. Acts: move_tier · rank (up/down within a
5 tier) · rename · date · park (with its trigger) · unpark · flag / unflag (a native part's "needs you") · add (a
6 task, or a project part by reference) · promote (a seed, by id → an initiative, with the tier and the area he
7 picked) · withdraw / restore (the inverse of add and promote: the record is append-only, so a step is never
8 deleted — its navigation is cleared, which takes it off the board while the ordinary cockpit still shows it;
9 restore puts the navigation back). A tick on a native part waits on John's word on the close law (PLAN §9.6)
10 and is refused here with that sentence. The Campaign never writes another record: a date or a flip on a
11 referenced part is refused by the engine and the refusal is the receipt.
12 """

27 def _cli(project, *args):
28     r = subprocess.run(["node", str(ECG), *args, "--project", str(project)], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=60)
29     try:
30         return json.loads(r.stdout or "{}")
31     except Exception:
32         return {"ok": False, "error": "engine answered no json", "raw": (r.stdout or r.stderr)[:200]}

35 def _spine_set(project, step_id, fields):
36     js = ("import { appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine } from '%s';"
37           "const r = appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(%s, {kind:'step_set', step_id:%s, fields:%s});"
38           "console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:r.ok, error:r.error||null}));") % (
39         SPINE, json.dumps(str(project).replace("\\", "/")), json.dumps(step_id), json.dumps(fields))
40     r = subprocess.run(["node", "--input-type=module", "-e", js], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=60)
41     try:
42         return json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
43     except Exception:
44         return {"ok": False, "error": (r.stderr or r.stdout)[:200] or "the spine answered nothing"}

59 def _own_group(s):
60     nav = s.get("navigation") if isinstance(s.get("navigation"), dict) else {}
61     return next((g for g in nav.get("groups") or [] if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("id") == s.get("id") and g.get("parent_id") is None), None)

64 def _initiatives(project):

73 def _parts_of(project, sid):

96 def _write_nav(project, s, order=None):
97     """Write the heading step's navigation back whole, with only its own group's order changed."""
98     nav = dict(s.get("navigation") or {})
99     groups = [dict(g) for g in nav.get("groups") or []]
100     for g in groups:
101         if g.get("id") == s.get("id") and order is not None:
102             g["order"] = int(order)
103     nav["groups"] = groups
104     nav.setdefault("path", [s.get("id")])
105     return _spine_set(project, s["id"], {"navigation": nav})

108 def _foot(project, tier, except_id=None):
109     return max([int(g.get("order") or 0) for x, g in _initiatives(project) if x.get("tier") == tier and x.get("id") != except_id] or [-1]) + 1

114 def move_tier(project, step, tier, order=None):
115     """Move an initiative to a tier: one step_set of its tier, then its place — the foot of that tier, or the
116     order the undo carries (so a head of a tier comes back as its head, not at the bottom with a new number)."""
117     s = _step(project, step)
118     if s is None or _own_group(s) is None:
119         return _no("no such goal")
120     try:
121         tier = int(tier)
122     except Exception:
123         return _no("a tier is 1, 2 or 3")
124     if tier not in (1, 2, 3):
125         return _no("a tier is 1, 2 or 3")
126     old = s.get("tier")
127     old_order = int(_own_group(s).get("order") or 0)
128     if old == tier:
129         return _no("%s is already in tier %d" % (s.get("name"), tier))
130     r = _cli(project, "roadmap-set", "--step", step, "--tier", str(tier))
131     if not r.get("ok"):
132         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
133     place = int(order) if order is not None else _foot(project, tier, except_id=step)
134     r2 = _write_nav(project, _step(project, step), order=place)
135     if not r2.get("ok"):
136         return _no("%s moved to tier %d, but its place there was refused: %s — it keeps its old order number" % (s.get("name"), tier, r2.get("error")))
137     return _ok("%s moved to tier %d (from %s), %s" % (s.get("name"), tier, ("tier %d" % old) if old else "no tier",
138                                                       ("at its foot" if order is None else "back in its place")),
139                undo={"act": "move_tier", "step": step, "tier": old, "order": old_order} if old else None)
140

142 def rank(project, step, direction):
143     """Move an initiative up or down within its tier. The tier is first renumbered to its sorted positions
144     (a write only where an order differs — equal orders would otherwise make Up sort later), then the two
145     neighbours swap; a refused second write puts the first back."""
146     s = _step(project, step)
147     if s is None or _own_group(s) is None:
148         return _no("no such goal")
149     same = sorted([(int(g.get("order") or 0), x) for x, g in _initiatives(project) if x.get("tier") == s.get("tier")], key=lambda t: (t[0], t[1].get("name") or ""))
150     idx = next((k for k, (o, x) in enumerate(same) if x.get("id") == step), None)
151     if idx is None:
152         return _no("not in a tier")
153     j = idx - 1 if direction == "up" else idx + 1
154     if j < 0 or j >= len(same):
155         return _no("%s is already at the %s of its tier — the Tier menu moves it between tiers" % (s.get("name"), "top" if direction == "up" else "foot"))
156     for k, (o, x) in enumerate(same):
157         if o != k:
158             r0 = _write_nav(project, x, order=k)
159             if not r0.get("ok"):
160                 return _no("the tier could not be renumbered: %s" % r0.get("error"))
161     mover, other = same[idx][1], same[j][1]
162     r1 = _write_nav(project, other, order=idx)
163     if not r1.get("ok"):
164         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r1.get("error"))
165     r2 = _write_nav(project, mover, order=j)
166     if not r2.get("ok"):
167         _write_nav(project, other, order=j)
168         return _no("the engine refused: %s — nothing moved" % r2.get("error"))
169     return _ok("%s moved %s within tier %s, past %s" % (s.get("name"), direction, s.get("tier"), other.get("name")),
170                undo={"act": "rank", "step": step, "direction": "down" if direction == "up" else "up"})

285 def promote(project, seed_id, tier, area, done_when=None):
286     """A seed (by its id on the strip) becomes an initiative: the heading step with the tier and area he picked,
287     its root group at the foot of that tier, and the seed spent by one later receipt that cites its id."""
288     seed = seed_by_id(project, seed_id)
289     if seed is None:
290         return _no("no such seed — the row above the board is the list")
291     text = seed["text"]
292     try:
293         tier = int(tier) if str(tier or "").strip() else 3
294     except Exception:
295         return _no("a tier is 1, 2 or 3")
296     if tier not in (1, 2, 3):
297         return _no("a tier is 1, 2 or 3")
298     sid = _slug(text)
299     if _step(project, sid) is not None:
300         return _no("a goal with that name exists already")
301     args = ["roadmap-propose", "--step", sid, "--name", text, "--tier", str(tier), "--done-when", done_when or "not written yet — say what done looks like"]
302     if area:
303         args += ["--area", str(area)]
304     r = _cli(project, *args)
305     if not r.get("ok"):
306         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
307     r2 = _spine_set(project, sid, {"navigation": {"path": [sid], "groups": [{"id": sid, "label": text, "order": _foot(project, tier), "parent_id": None}], "role": "primary"}})
308     if not r2.get("ok"):
309         return _no("the heading was written but not grouped: %s" % r2.get("error"))
310     r3 = _cli(project, "grasscatch", "--deferred", text, "--reason", "promoted seed %s → the initiative %s, by John on the Campaign" % (seed["id"], sid))
311     spent = " — but the seed could not be spent on the strip: %s" % r3.get("error") if not r3.get("ok") else ""
312     try:   # a goal made from a seed asks its premortem too (2026-10-03, Grok code R1 F3)
313         from . import nudges as _n
314         _n.ask_premortem(project, sid, "a new goal")
315     except Exception:
316         pass
317     return _ok("%s is now a goal in tier %d%s%s" % (text, tier, (" · " + str(area)) if area else "", spent),
318                undo={"act": "withdraw", "step": sid, "seed": seed["id"]}, step=sid)

321 def retag(project, step, initiative):
322     """A part moves to another initiative: one step_set of its navigation path. A heading is refused."""
323     s = _step(project, step)
324     if s is None:
325         return _no("no such part")
326     if _own_group(s) is not None:
327         return _no("%s is a goal, not a part — the Tier menu moves it" % s.get("name"))
328     head = _step(project, initiative)
329     if head is None or _own_group(head) is None:
330         return _no("no such goal")
331     nav = dict(s.get("navigation") or {})
332     old = list(nav.get("path") or [])
333     if old and old[0] == initiative:
334         return _no("%s is already under %s" % (s.get("name"), head.get("name")))
335     nav["path"] = [initiative]
336     r = _spine_set(project, step, {"navigation": nav})
337     if not r.get("ok"):
338         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
339     return _ok("%s moved to %s" % (s.get("name"), head.get("name")), undo={"act": "retag", "step": step, "initiative": old[0]} if old else None)

342 def withdraw(project, step, seed=None):
343     """The inverse of add and promote. The record is append-only, so nothing is deleted: the step's navigation
344     is cleared (one step_set), which takes it off the board; the ordinary cockpit still shows it. A heading that
345     has parts is refused (the engine would refuse their paths). With a seed id, the seed is given back."""
346     s = _step(project, step)
347     if s is None:
348         return _no("no such part")
349     old_nav = s.get("navigation")
350     if not old_nav:
351         return _no("%s is already off the board" % s.get("name"))
352     if _own_group(s) is not None and _parts_of(project, step):
353         return _no("%s has parts now — move them first, then withdraw it" % s.get("name"))
354     r = _spine_set(project, step, {"navigation": None})
355     if not r.get("ok"):
356         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
357     back = ""
358     if seed:
359         r2 = _cli(project, "grasscatch", "--deferred", s.get("name") or "", "--reason", "restored seed %s — the initiative %s was undone by John on the Campaign" % (seed, step))
360         back = " and the seed is back above the board" if r2.get("ok") else " — but the seed could not be restored on the strip: %s" % r2.get("error")
361     return _ok("%s withdrawn — off the board; the record keeps it (the cockpit shows it)%s" % (s.get("name"), back),
362                undo={"act": "restore", "step": step, "navigation": old_nav, "seed": seed})
363

404 def _seat_ids(project, seat, except_id=None):
405     """The components in a seat, in his order."""
406     rows = [(x.get("seat_order") if isinstance(x.get("seat_order"), int) else 999, x.get("name") or "", x["id"])
407             for x in _projection(project) if x.get("seat") == seat and x["id"] != except_id and x.get("status") not in ("done", "parked")]
408     return [sid for _o, _n, sid in sorted(rows)]

422 def _place_seat(project, step, seat, position):
423     """Put a component at a position in a seat's order; the others close up. The first refused write is the error."""
424     ids = _seat_ids(project, seat, except_id=step)
425     position = max(0, min(int(position), len(ids)))
426     ids.insert(position, step)
427     for k, sid in enumerate(ids):
428         cur = _step(project, sid)
429         if cur.get("seat_order") != k:
430             r = _cli(project, "roadmap-set", "--step", sid, "--seat-order", str(k))
431             if not r.get("ok"):
432                 return "the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error")
433     return None

436 def _component(project, step):
437     """The step as a seatable component, or a refusal."""
438     s = _step(project, step)
439     if s is None:
440         return None, _no("no such part")
441     if _own_group(s) is not None:
442         names = ", ".join((x.get("name") or x["id"]) for x in _parts_of(project, step) if _kind_of(x) in INITIATIVE_KINDS)[:200]
443         return None, _no("%s is a goal \u2014 a goal has no seat; name one of its components%s" % (s.get("name"), (": " + names) if names else ""))
444     if _kind_of(s) not in INITIATIVE_KINDS:
445         return None, _no("%s is a %s \u2014 it rides inside its goal; a cockpit, an effort or a desk item takes a seat" % (s.get("name"), _kind_of(s)))
446     return s, None

449 def seat(project, step, seat, position=None):
450     """Put a component on the desk: ACTIVE or ON DECK, at a position (the foot when none); one receipt naming the
451     seat as it now is; the undo puts it back where it sat (its old seat and place, or its goal)."""
452     s, refusal = _component(project, step)
453     if refusal:
454         return refusal
455     seat = str(seat or "").strip().lower()
456     if seat not in SEATS:
457         return _no("a seat is active or deck")
458     old_seat = s.get("seat") if s.get("seat") in SEATS else None
459     old_pos = _seat_ids(project, old_seat).index(step) if old_seat and step in _seat_ids(project, old_seat) else None
460     if old_seat == seat and position is None:
461         return _no("%s is already %s" % (s.get("name"), "active" if seat == "active" else "on deck"))
462     place = int(position) if position is not None else len(_seat_ids(project, seat, except_id=step))
463     r = _cli(project, "roadmap-set", "--step", step, "--seat-in", seat, "--seat-order", str(place))
464     if not r.get("ok"):
465         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
466     undo = {"act": "seat", "step": step, "seat": old_seat, "position": old_pos or 0} if old_seat else {"act": "home", "step": step}
467     err = _place_seat(project, step, seat, place)
468     if not err and old_seat and old_seat != seat:
469         err = _renumber_seat(project, old_seat)
470     if err:
471         return _no("%s is %s, but the order could not close up: %s \u2014 undo puts it back" % (s.get("name"), "active" if seat == "active" else "on deck", err), undo=undo)
472     g = _goal_of(project, s)
473     where = ("%s (%s)" % (s.get("name"), g.get("name"))) if g else s.get("name")
474     return _ok("%s is %s \u2014 %s" % (where, "active" if seat == "active" else "on deck", _seat_line(project, seat)), undo=undo)
475 
476 
477 def _renumber_seat(project, seat):
478     for k, sid in enumerate(_seat_ids(project, seat)):
479         cur = _step(project, sid)
480         if cur.get("seat_order") != k:
481             r = _cli(project, "roadmap-set", "--step", sid, "--seat-order", str(k))
482             if not r.get("ok"):
483                 return "the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error")
484     return None

487 def home(project, step):
488     """Send a component back into its goal (no seat); the seat it left closes up; the undo re-seats it where it was."""
489     s, refusal = _component(project, step)
490     if refusal:
491         return refusal
492     old_seat = s.get("seat") if s.get("seat") in SEATS else None
493     if not old_seat:
494         return _no("%s is in its goal already" % s.get("name"))
495     old_pos = _seat_ids(project, old_seat).index(step) if step in _seat_ids(project, old_seat) else 0
496     r = _cli(project, "roadmap-set", "--step", step, "--seat-in", "none")
497     if not r.get("ok"):
498         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
499     undo = {"act": "seat", "step": step, "seat": old_seat, "position": old_pos}
500     err = _renumber_seat(project, old_seat)
501     if err:
502         return _no("%s is back in its goal, but %s could not close up: %s \u2014 undo puts it back" % (s.get("name"), "Active" if old_seat == "active" else "On deck", err), undo=undo)
503     g = _goal_of(project, s)
504     return _ok("%s back in %s \u2014 %s" % (s.get("name"), g.get("name") if g else "its goal", _seat_line(project, old_seat)), undo=undo)

507 def new_goal(project, text, tier=None, area=None, done_when=None):
508     """A goal from his words (no seed): the heading step with its tier and its root group at the foot of that tier."""
509     text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
510     if not text:
511         return _no("a goal needs a name")
512     try:
513         tier = int(tier) if str(tier or "").strip() else 3
514     except Exception:
515         return _no("a tier is 1, 2 or 3")
516     if tier not in (1, 2, 3):
517         return _no("a tier is 1, 2 or 3")
518     sid = _slug(text)
519     if _step(project, sid) is not None:
520         return _no("a goal with that name exists already")
521     args = ["roadmap-propose", "--step", sid, "--name", text, "--tier", str(tier), "--done-when", done_when or "not written yet \u2014 say what done looks like"]
522     if area:
523         args += ["--area", str(area)]
524     r = _cli(project, *args)
525     if not r.get("ok"):
526         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
527     r2 = _spine_set(project, sid, {"navigation": {"path": [sid], "groups": [{"id": sid, "label": text, "order": _foot(project, tier), "parent_id": None}], "role": "primary"}})
528     if not r2.get("ok"):
529         return _no("the heading was written but not grouped: %s" % r2.get("error"))
530     try:   # the Star Chart asks its premortem once on a new goal (2026-10-03)
531         from . import nudges as _n
532         _n.ask_premortem(project, sid, "a new goal")
533     except Exception:
534         pass
535     return _ok("%s is now a goal in tier %d%s" % (text, tier, (" \u00b7 " + str(area)) if area else ""), undo={"act": "withdraw", "step": sid}, step=sid)
536

538 def pace(project, step, when):
539     """The date he drives an initiative toward (YYYY-MM-DD, or none)."""
540     s = _step(project, step)
541     if s is None or _own_group(s) is None:
542         return _no("no such goal")
543     when = str(when or "").strip() or "none"
544     r = _cli(project, "roadmap-set", "--step", step, "--pace", when)
545     if not r.get("ok"):
546         return _no("the engine refused: %s (a pace is YYYY-MM-DD, or none)" % r.get("error"))
547     old = s.get("pace") or "none"
548     if old != "none" and when != "none" and when > old:   # the pace slipped later: the Star Chart asks its premortem (2026-10-03)
549         try:
550             from . import nudges as _n
551             _n.ask_premortem(project, step, "its pace moved from %s to %s" % (old, when))
552         except Exception:
553             pass
554     return _ok("%s: the pace is %s" % (s.get("name"), ("now " + when) if when != "none" else "cleared"), undo={"act": "pace", "step": step, "when": old})

557 def done_when(project, step, text):
558     """Revise a goal — what done looks like — on its initiative (the goal's place, W2 v2)."""

574 def _tier_ids(project, tier, except_id=None):
575     same = sorted([(int(g.get("order") or 0), x.get("name") or "", x["id"]) for x, g in _initiatives(project) if x.get("tier") == tier and x["id"] != except_id])
576     return [sid for _o, _n, sid in same]

579 def _place_tier(project, step, tier, position):
580     """Put an initiative at a position in its tier's order; the others close up. The first refused write is the error."""
581     ids = _tier_ids(project, tier, except_id=step)
582     position = max(0, min(int(position), len(ids)))
583     ids.insert(position, step)
584     for k, sid in enumerate(ids):
585         cur = _step(project, sid)
586         if int((_own_group(cur) or {}).get("order") or 0) != k:
587             r = _write_nav(project, cur, order=k)
588             if not r.get("ok"):
589                 return "the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error")
590     return None

593 def place(project, step, band, position=0, tier=None, tier_position=None):
594     """ONE act for a drop of a goal on the board: into a tier's band (1 · 2 · 3, the last being the seed goals). The
595     tier only \u2014 his word: no ranking inside a tier. One receipt; the undo is the old tier."""
596     s = _step(project, step)
597     if s is None or _own_group(s) is None:
598         return _no("no such goal")
599     band = str(band or "").strip().lower()
600     if band not in ("1", "2", "3"):
601         return _no("a band is a tier 1, 2 or 3")
602     tier = int(band)
603     old_tier = s.get("tier") if s.get("tier") in (1, 2, 3) else None
604     if old_tier == tier:
605         return _no("%s is already in tier %d \u2014 there is no order inside a tier" % (s.get("name"), tier))
606     r = move_tier(project, step, tier)
607     if not r.get("ok"):
608         return r
609     return _ok("%s moved to tier %d" % (s.get("name"), tier), undo={"act": "place", "step": step, "band": str(old_tier), "position": 0} if old_tier else None)

679 PREMORTEM_Q = "It is three months on and this goal fell short: what went wrong?"
680 
681 
682 def premortem(project, step, text):
683     """His answer to the premortem goes into the goal's guide under '## Premortem', then the ask is closed."""
684     s = _step(project, step)
685     if s is None or _own_group(s) is None:
686         return _no("no such goal")
687     answer = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
688     if not answer:
689         return _no("say what went wrong, in a sentence")
690     import time as _time
691     from .steward_campaign import read_guide, write_guide
692     from . import nudges as _n
693     g = read_guide(project, step)
694     body = (g.get("text") or ("# %s\n" % (s.get("name") or step))).rstrip("\n")
695     block = "## Premortem, %s\n%s\n%s" % (_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), PREMORTEM_Q, answer)
696     lines = body.split("\n")
697     h = next((k for k, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.strip().lower() == "## history"), None)
698     if h is not None:
699         body = "\n".join(lines[:h]).rstrip("\n") + "\n\n" + block + "\n\n" + "\n".join(lines[h:])
700     else:
701         body = body + "\n\n" + block + "\n"
702     r = write_guide(project, step, body, who="John")
703     if not r.get("ok"):
704         return _no(str(r.get("error") or "the guide was not written"))
705     _n.close_premortem(project, step)
706     return _ok("the premortem of %s is in its guide" % s.get("name"), undo=None, updated=r.get("updated"))
707

723 def seat_new(project, ref, name, seat_to):
724     """A candidate not yet on the Campaign - a cockpit (project:<pid>) or a cockpit within a project
725     (effort:<pid>/<dir>) - put on the desk in one act (his word, 2026-10-02: "a tile ... right below the on deck that
726     shows all of the candidates ... anything with an AI Cockpit"): it becomes a component in no goal, then takes the
727     seat. One receipt; the undo withdraws it. A ref already on the map is seated as it is (never a second card)."""
728     from steward_cockpit.campaign_parts import parse_ref
729     ref = str(ref or "").strip()
730     p = parse_ref(ref)
731     if p is None or p.get("kind") not in ("project", "effort"):
732         return _no("a candidate is a cockpit (project:) or a cockpit within a project (effort:)")
733     seat_to = str(seat_to or "").strip().lower()
734     if seat_to not in SEATS:
735         return _no("a seat is active or deck")
736     there = next((x for x in _projection(project) if str(x.get("ref") or "") == ref and x.get("status") not in ("done",)), None)
737     if there is not None:
738         return seat(project, there["id"], seat_to)
739     name = " ".join(str(name or "").split())[:120] or ref
740     sid, n = _slug(name, "cand"), 2
741     while _step(project, sid) is not None:
742         sid, n = "%s-%d" % (_slug(name, "cand"), n), n + 1
743     r = _cli(project, "roadmap-propose", "--step", sid, "--name", name, "--ref", ref)
744     if not r.get("ok"):
745         return _no("the engine refused: %s" % r.get("error"))
746     out = seat(project, sid, seat_to)
747     if not out.get("ok"):
748         withdraw(project, sid)
749         return out
750     out["undo"] = {"act": "withdraw", "step": sid}
751     return out
752

754 def act(project, body):
755     """Dispatch one act from the page; every answer is a receipt sentence, ok or refused."""
756     body = body if isinstance(body, dict) else {}
757     a = str(body.get("act") or "")
758     if a not in ACTS:
759         return _no("no such act")
760     try:
761         if a == "move_tier":
762             return move_tier(project, body.get("step"), body.get("tier"), body.get("order"))
763         if a == "rank":
764             return rank(project, body.get("step"), "up" if body.get("direction") == "up" else "down")
765         if a == "rename":
766             return rename(project, body.get("step"), body.get("name"))
767         if a == "date":
768             return date(project, body.get("step"), body.get("due"))
769         if a == "park":
770             return park(project, body.get("step"), body.get("waiting_on"))
771         if a == "unpark":
772             return unpark(project, body.get("step"))
773         if a == "flag":
774             return flag(project, body.get("step"), True)
775         if a == "unflag":
776             return flag(project, body.get("step"), False)
777         if a == "tick":
778             return tick(project, body.get("step"))
779         if a == "add":
780             return add(project, body.get("initiative"), body.get("kind"), body.get("text"), body.get("due"), body.get("project_id"))
781         if a == "promote":
782             return promote(project, body.get("seed"), body.get("tier"), body.get("area"), body.get("done_when"))
783         if a == "retag":
784             return retag(project, body.get("step"), body.get("initiative"))
785         if a == "seat":
786             return seat(project, body.get("step"), body.get("seat"), body.get("position"))
787         if a == "home":
788             return home(project, body.get("step"))
789         if a == "new_goal":
790             return new_goal(project, body.get("text"), body.get("tier"), body.get("area"), body.get("done_when"))
791         if a == "done_when":
792             return done_when(project, body.get("step"), body.get("text"))
793         if a == "place":
794             return place(project, body.get("step"), body.get("band"), body.get("position") or 0)
795         if a == "pace":
796             return pace(project, body.get("step"), body.get("when"))
797         if a == "withdraw":
798             return withdraw(project, body.get("step"), body.get("seed"))
799         if a == "restore":
800             return restore(project, body.get("step"), body.get("navigation"), body.get("seed"))
801         if a == "guide":
802             return guide(project, body.get("step"), body.get("text"))
803         if a == "not_now":
804             return not_now(project, body.get("key"), body.get("fact"), body.get("text"))
805         if a == "nudge_again":
806             return nudge_again(project, body.get("key"))
807         if a == "seat_new":
808             return seat_new(project, body.get("ref"), body.get("name"), body.get("seat"))
809         if a == "resume":
810             return resume(project, body.get("note"), body.get("switched_to"))
811         if a == "resume_done":
812             return resume_done(project)
813         if a == "if_then":
814             return if_then(project, body.get("step"), body.get("text"))
815         if a == "premortem":
816             return premortem(project, body.get("step"), body.get("text"))
817         if a == "premortem_skip":
818             return premortem_skip(project, body.get("step"))
819         if a == "premortem_ask":
820             return premortem_ask(project, body.get("step"), body.get("reason"))
821     except Exception as e:
822         return _no("that did not go through: %s" % e)
823     return _no("no such act")
